ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, April 16, 2018 and to business minors on Monday, April 23, 2018 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Informatics Minor students on Monday, April 30, 2018 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
